title: Contracts Office Note: Lender Amendment Fee on Reinstated Design Studio Selections Lines
content:
A reinstated Design Studio Selections line carries a lender amendment fee set by the financing of the Home Purchase Agreement the file serves:

| Financing on the Home Purchase Agreement | Lender amendment fee |
|---|---|
| Outside lender | The purchase collection's contract amendment fee |
| Cash | 50 percent of the purchase collection's contract amendment fee |
| Calloway Home Mortgage | Nothing |

**Records read.** The financing type on the Home Purchase Agreement, and the contract amendment fee of the agreement's collection under the Home Purchase Agreement.

*Hypothetical figures:* where the collection's contract amendment fee is 300.00, an outside-lender agreement adds 300.00, a cash agreement adds 150.00 and a Calloway Home Mortgage agreement adds nothing.
